subject.title: fix(gateway): regenerate native hook descriptors when relay unavailable after restart

question: Should generic OpenClaw `before_tool_call` policy be the approved fallback when the Codex native relay fails before any handler invocation?
rationale: The code can distinguish pre-invocation from post-invocation failure, but choosing an alternate authorization path remains an intentional security-boundary decision.

options.title: Approve bounded fallback
options.body: Allow fallback only when no invocation was recorded, while retaining fail-closed behavior for handler crashes, malformed results, and explicit denials.

options.title: Require relay recovery first
options.body: Keep the request blocked until the current relay descriptor is regenerated or re-registered and native PreToolUse enforcement resumes.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded fallback
recommendation.body: Allow fallback only when no invocation was recorded, while retaining fail-closed behavior for handler crashes, malformed results, and explicit denials.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior merged guarded unavailable behavior in these same relay surfaces provides the strongest available ownership signal for this boundary.
